notes.title: Update: New Variant - Aleut Chess
notes.content:
Hi, thanks to everyone for playing The Chess Variants Club.

We've just released an update (v0.1.12) introducing a new variant: Aleut Chess

In the 1933 book "History, Ethnography and Anthropology of the Aleut", W. Jochelson reported a game played by the Aleut people, in Alaska. 
It had similarities with chess, probably adapted from the Russians, given the similar figure names. 
Peculiar features include a 7x8 board, and the initial setup of the pieces, with starting positions different for white and black.
The variant was implemented based on these reports.

More information [url=https://www.mayhematics.com/s/yakut.htm]here[/url]

We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37617614/7d3e21b1285f6141a19e7c35f92917c07acc7d47.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: We've just released an update (v0.1.12) introducing a new variant: Aleut Chess

notes.title: Update - Play a chess variant match remotely with a friend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37617614/ad9102116ef3942234f7f12f3ce88e3e285175a6.jpg[/img]

Now you can play a chess variant match remotely with a friend, through the Steam Remote Play Together feature.

Update v0.1.11 is here.
[list]
[*] Invite your friend to play with you. He/she doesn't need to have a Steam account - see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]here[/url]; 
[*] The remote player can use the shared mouse, the shared keyboard, or a gamepad (it currently works for a limited set of controller models).
[*] The input devices to be shared are defined by the player who made the invitation and is running the game;
[*] The definition of which input device will be used by which player is made at the start of each match.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy it!
